budgetPolicy: All budgets are pre-execution proposals per invocation, not implementation-duration estimates. First over-budget event stops downstream dispatch, freezes partial evidence and diagnoses owner/toolchain/contract-duration/UNKNOWN; never silently extends the budget.

atomicCutover.inventoryInput: historical source-audit plus required fresh execution-source all-language/import/member/native-tag/export scan
atomicCutover.publicationPreconditions: all selected consumers/gates/registry/platform obligations and current-source independent review; no active partial rollout
delete: direct/re-exported LobeUI/antd/lucide/react-layout-kit foundation surfaces in selected consumers
atomicCutover.rollback: later authorized atomic source cut commit may be reverted as a complete unit; no retained compatibility wrapper/runtime toggle or partial destructive commands
atomicCutover.scopeExclusions: explicit reviewed NOT_APPLICABLE per consumer, never silence an unimplemented actual consumer
